title: Apply for a new pensioner refund on a Mobility Parking Scheme permit
summary: Find out if you are eligible for a partial refund on your Mobility Parking Scheme permit if you become a pensioner.
intro: If you have a Mobility Parking Scheme permit and become a pensioner while holding the permit, you may be eligible for a partial refund. You'll need to provide evidence that you're a pensioner when you visit a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: You must have a Mobility Parking Scheme permit and become a pensioner while holding that permit.

faqs.q: What should I do if I become a pensioner while holding a Mobility Parking Scheme permit?
faqs.a: You may be eligible for a partial refund. You must provide evidence that you are a pensioner when you visit a Service NSW Centre.
